answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable bond that is slashed when peers catch coordinated duplicate behavior. Forging a crowd then costs real capital per fake: like ferrous filings drawn to one magnet, sybils funded from a single source cluster visibly and get exposed together. An honest agent climbs toward its zenith one attested epoch at a time, while an attacker must stake fresh funds for every plume of smoke they fake.
